summary: ChowChow Cloud International Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting entry into a securities purchase agreement for the issuance and sale of 862,069 ordinary shares at $0.58 per share for $500,000 aggregate proceeds, via a private placement under Regulation S. The filing describes customary representations, warranties, and a 24-month restriction on further share issuances or registration statements without the purchaser's consent. Closing is expected on or about June 22, 2026. This is a routine capital-raising transaction without any control premium, board recommendation, or structural complexity typical of special situations; no deal terms are disclosed beyond the price and share count. There is no special-situations angle to monitor.
